title: American Chicken Stew
description: A rich and comforting dish featuring coriander seeds, perfect for a sick day, this slow-cooked stew is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and has a glassy-jelly texture.
instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the coriander seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, thyme, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and shred it into bite-sized pieces.
Return the shredded chicken to the pot and add the gelatin, stirring to combine.
Continue to simmer, uncovered, for an additional 10 minutes, or until the stew has thickened and has a glassy-jelly texture.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
